paper_metadata.title: Applications of Vedic Computing for Quantum Computing
paper_metadata.venue: Engineering Archive (Engrxiv) (implied from references, not explicitly stated for this specific paper)

summary: The paper is a conceptual and survey-style discussion of how Vedic Computing ideas might be applied to quantum computing, covering algorithms, error correction, cryptography, and optimization, but it does not present any concrete experiments, benchmarks, or quantitative performance results.
